nodes.summary: Let $G$ be an abelian group and let $n$ be the least natural number $m$ such that every sequence of $m$ elements of $G$ has a nonempty subsequence with product $1$ (the Davenport constant of $G$). Let $r$ and $t$ be natural numbers with $n < t < r$. Then for every sequence $s_1, \dots, s_r$ of elements of $G$, the number $M$ of sets $S \subseteq \{1, \dots, r\}$ with $t - n \le |S| \le t$ and…
nodes.title: Alford–Granville–Pomerance count of zero-sum subsequences

nodes.summary: Let $1 < \theta < 2$. There are real constants $\gamma > 0$ and $Y$ such that for every real $y > Y$, the number of primes $q$ with $y^\theta / \log y \le q \le y^\theta$ such that every prime divisor of $q - 1$ is at most $y$ is at least $\gamma y^\theta / \log(y^\theta)$.
nodes.title: Many primes $q$ with $q - 1$ smooth

nodes.summary: Assume Heath-Brown's conjecture in the following form: there is a real constant $C$ such that for every natural number $d \ge 2$ and every natural number $c$ coprime to $d$ there is a prime $p \equiv c \pmod{d}$ with $p \le C d (\log d)^2$. nodes.title: Carmichael numbers with a prime number of prime factors in a range

nodes.summary: There is a real constant $C$ such that for every natural number $d \ge 1$ and every natural number $c$ coprime to $d$, there is a prime $p \equiv c \pmod{d}$ with $p \le C d^{5.2}$.
nodes.title: Linnik's theorem with exponent 5.2 (Xylouris)

nodes.summary: Suppose there is a real constant $C$ such that for every natural number $d \ge 2$ and every natural number $c$ coprime to $d$ there is a prime $p \equiv c \pmod{d}$ with $p \le C d (\log d)^2$ (Heath-Brown's conjecture on the least prime in an arithmetic progression). Then there are infinitely many Carmichael numbers $n$ whose number of prime factors counted with multiplicity, $\Omega(n)$, is prime.
nodes.title: Infinitely many Carmichael numbers with a prime number of prime factors (conditional)

nodes.summary: A natural number $n > 1$ is a Carmichael number if and only if $n$ is squarefree, $p - 1$ divides $n - 1$ for every prime divisor $p$ of $n$, and $n$ is not prime.
nodes.title: Korselt's criterion

nodes.summary: A natural number $n$ is a Carmichael number if and only if $n > 1$, $n$ is not prime, and $x^n = x$ for every element $x$ of $\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Carmichael numbers via the residue ring

nodes.summary: A natural number $n$ is a Carmichael number if $n > 1$, $n$ is not prime, and $a^n \equiv a \pmod{n}$ for every natural number $a$.
nodes.title: Carmichael numbers

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
